sources.title: Run Gemma with the Gemini API | Google AI for Developers
sources.snippet: The Gemini API provides hosted access to Gemma as a programming API you can use in application development or prototyping. This API is a convenient alternative to setting up your own local instance of Gemma and web service to handle generative AI tasks.
